firmware.title: MS 0585 (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The Elektronika MS 0585, a PDP-11 office computer, with the MS 1702 and the hard disk. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
